name: Frame transport
responsibility: Writes and reads newline-framed JSON over the stdio of the child, and tells each owner what arrived
description: TASK-653.11: createCodexTransport is private; openCodexConnection opens it over the child's stdio with the connection's identity authority. It writes each frame through encodeFrame and turns a refusal into its write error (a usage error for a value with no JSON form, else frame-too-large). replaceIdentity, its dead call and the ?? fallbacks are gone from CodexTransport (owner decision 22). Its error classes stay inside, under their names and messages, and callers read them through readCodexFailure.
